title: Log regularity and triviality locus under etale restriction
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian fine saturated log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] which is log regular. Let W -> X be etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] with W locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and let N be a log structure whose underlying prelog structure equals the canonical slice restriction [def-trf-log-etale-restriction-stalk-comparison] of the log structure of X. Then N is fine saturated and log regular, and its triviality locus is the inverse image of the triviality locus of X.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.2 and 1.6--1.7, printed pp. 69--70; characteristic faces and descent of free chart parameters, extracted from returned proof steps 7--8.

proof.text: For a pointed etale object W, its pointed neighbourhood category is the corresponding slice of the pointed neighbourhood category of X. The forgetful functor is initial: a neighbourhood is refined by its fibre product with W. The colimit formula identifies the log stalk and the ring stalk, their structural maps, and units. This is the etale special case directly; the stronger ind-etale invariance theorem is unnecessary.

Restrict an fs chart after fibre product with W. The stalk isomorphisms preserve its pushout condition, its characteristic group rank, and its nonunit ideal and quotient. Hence they preserve both the stratum regularity and the dimension equation. This proves fine saturation and log regularity.

The stalk isomorphism preserves subsingleton characteristics. For the converse at a point, lift any geometric point at its image through that point of W: the residue extension of an etale map is finite separable and its embedding extends into the algebraically closed field. The same stalk identification gives the equivalence of the universally quantified triviality conditions.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_logRegular_restriction
    (X : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}) (hX : X.IsLogRegular)
    (W : X.scheme.Etale) [IsLocallyNoetherian W.left]
    (N : EtaleLogStructure W.left)
    (hN : N.toEtalePrelogStructure = X.logStructure.toEtalePrelogStructure.etaleRestrict W) :
    (∃ hfs : N.IsFineSaturated,
      FineSaturatedLogScheme.IsLogRegular ⟨W.left, inferInstance, N, hfs⟩) ∧
      W.hom ⁻¹' X.logStructure.trivialityLocus = N.trivialityLocus
